parameters.name: FileSystemType
parameters.description:
The type of the file system.

Valid value:

*   standard: General-purpose Apsara File Storage NAS (NAS) file system
*   extreme: Extreme NAS file system.
*   cpfs: CPFS file system.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where you want to query zones.

You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the latest region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas describe-zones --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --file-system-type standard --region cn-hangzhou
